title: 12 Best Jewish Delis in New York City (2026)
description: The best Jewish delis in NYC — from legendary pastrami palaces to beloved smoked fish counters.

picks.name: Katz's Delicatessen
picks.address: 205 E Houston St, New York, NY 10002
picks.verdict: The undisputed king of NYC delis — operating since 1888 and still hand-cutting pastrami that makes grown men weep.
picks.whatToOrder: Hand-cut pastrami on rye — accept no substitutions. Add a side of matzo ball soup and a Dr. Brown's Cream Soda.

picks.name: 2nd Ave Deli
picks.verdict: The locals' pick for the best classic Jewish deli in NYC — consistently rated above Katz's by actual New Yorkers on Reddit.
picks.whatToOrder: Pastrami sandwich or the combination (pastrami + corned beef). The matzo ball soup is among the best in the city. Don't skip the free coleslaw and pickles.

picks.name: Russ & Daughters
picks.address: 179 E Houston St, New York, NY 10002
picks.verdict: Not a deli in the pastrami sense — Russ & Daughters is the gold standard of Jewish appetizing, and the best smoked fish counter in America.
picks.whatToOrder: The Classic board (Nova Scotia salmon, sturgeon, cream cheese, bagel). For sandwiches, get the Super Heebster (whitefish + baked salmon salad + horseradish cream cheese).

picks.name: Barney Greengrass
picks.verdict: The 'Sturgeon King' since 1908 — a legendary Upper West Side institution that feels frozen in time, in the best possible way.
picks.whatToOrder: Eggs and Nova Scotia salmon scramble, or a sturgeon platter. The chopped liver is legendary. Get a bialy if they have them.

picks.name: Liebman's Deli
picks.verdict: Reddit's sleeper pick — consistently called 'the greatest Jewish deli in NYC right now' by people who've tried them all.
picks.whatToOrder: Corned beef or pastrami on rye. The portions are massive. Matzo ball soup is homestyle perfection. Grab a knish on the side.

picks.name: Sarge's Delicatessen & Diner
picks.verdict: The under-the-radar Midtown workhorse — massive portions, classic deli fare, and none of the tourist frenzy.
picks.whatToOrder: The triple-decker pastrami and corned beef sandwich is comically large. Matzo ball soup is solid. Breakfast platters are excellent too.

picks.name: Pastrami Queen
picks.verdict: The Upper East Side's answer to downtown pastrami — kosher, consistent, and beloved by the neighborhood.
picks.whatToOrder: Pastrami on rye (obviously). The hot dogs are old-school excellent. Romanian tenderloin if you're feeling fancy.

picks.name: Frankel's Delicatessen & Appetizing
picks.verdict: The new-school Jewish deli that Greenpoint deserves — thoughtful, delicious, and proof the tradition is evolving.
picks.whatToOrder: The egg sandwich on a bialy is legendary. Smoked fish plates are beautiful. Bagel with nova and cream cheese is a perfect simple pleasure.

picks.name: B&H Dairy
picks.verdict: The highest-rated spot on this list — a tiny kosher vegetarian counter that's been serving perfect challah French toast and matzo ball soup since the 1940s.
picks.whatToOrder: Challah French toast (legendary). Matzo ball soup. Mushroom barley soup. Blintzes. Everything is under $12.

picks.name: PJ Bernstein
picks.verdict: A true UES neighborhood gem — the kind of place where regulars have 'their usual' and the pastrami is always reliable.
picks.whatToOrder: Pastrami sandwich is the star. Matzo ball soup is excellent. The Reuben is also a safe bet. Good breakfast options too.

picks.name: Essen NY Deli
picks.verdict: The Brooklyn kosher deli powerhouse — massive portions, authentic preparation, and a true community institution.
picks.whatToOrder: The pastrami and corned beef sandwiches are enormous. Stuffed cabbage is homestyle perfection. Kasha varnishkes if you want real Ashkenazi comfort food.

picks.name: Ben's Kosher Delicatessen
picks.verdict: The outer-borough chain survivor — Ben's keeps the kosher deli tradition alive in Queens with solid classics and a catering operation.
picks.whatToOrder: Corned beef on rye is reliable. Matzo ball soup is comforting. The combo platters are good value for families.
